scope: Independent numerical and interpretation review of the report sources and compact summary; no final-PDF hash and no new atmosphere/observation fit.

numerical_checks.tex_rounding: Every B/C/R value agrees within 0.5 ppm and every Q improvement within 0.005 with its final receipt.
numerical_checks.summary_values: Every source/kinematic row uses its corresponding per-selection profiled baseline. Systematics remain fixed at the original planetary RV/amplitude and exact primary versus linear alternate values are distinguished.

interpretation_checks.free_structure: PASS: original-shape upper columns, nominal-center static radial optical depths, tau=1 radii and interpolated n2 match the corrected partial-cell integration receipt. Total column and upper column are distinguished.
interpretation_checks.optical_depth_scope: PASS: static outward radial diagnostics are explicitly not observer formation radii; peak per-cell line optical depths are separately described.
interpretation_checks.transfer_scope: PASS: relative observer-LOS offsets and actual radial-vector increments are distinguished; frozen profiles are not described as equilibrium solutions.
interpretation_checks.uncertainty: PASS: post-hoc target, conditional scores, correlated interleaves, empirical block uncertainty and absence of second-night complete-blue support prevent a causal/detection claim.
interpretation_checks.numerical_scope: PASS: source-only full-phase fine rays and opacity target-bracket refinement differ in scope; atmospheric eight-cell convergence remains unestablished.
interpretation_checks.time_scales: PASS: gross base rates and crossing times are not relaxation eigenvalues; missing receiving PI/RR packets and photon recycling are disclosed.

resolved_review_comments: Restricted the no-intrinsic-blue-emission statement to the pure-absorption limit, rather than every dim emitting layer.
Replaced uniform source-map wording with tested longitude source maps.
Labeled the radial free-model comparison as the original model-1 shape.
limitations: Literature references were checked against the local evidence context, not independently re-read from every primary paper in this review.
A favorable frozen direction or descriptive Q gain does not establish realizability or uniquely attribute the residual.
The final PDF build/layout is validated separately by the parent agent.
